There are two options available to you: A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around w

onal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API. Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations. Personal access tokens The API can be accessed by creating a Personal Access Token from t

om the Developers section of Harvest ID. After creating it you’ll be provided with a random token and a list of your account IDs. Personal Access Tokens are the preferred method when you want to write your own scripts that consume our API. Typical use cases for Personal Access Tokens are scripts that build custom report

custom reports, sync data between different accounts, or automate tasks that would otherwise take a long time when done manually. Personal Access Tokens replace the Basic Authentication method that was used in our v1 API, as this is more secure. Within the Developers section you’ll see a list of all your Personal Access

l your Personal Access Tokens, when they were last used, and you’ll be able to easily revoke them if necessary. Once generated, a Personal Access Token can be used to access the API by either providing the token in the Authorization header or including it in the query string.
